components.name: The Ribbon
components.description: The signature: a satin band lit from the top left, face Alliance 46 to Ribbon 57 to Ribbon Cyan, back Partner 38, edge Partner 30. The preview shows the face; the full form twists and is drawn by drawThread in brand-kit/index.html. Never a glow. About 15px wide at 1440 and about 8px on phones: it scales with the gutter, and the showcase keeps its side gutters at least 32px (--aap-space-gutter: 2rem) so the ribbon always has clear space beside the content.

narrative.overview:
One continuous ribbon, the one that binds the A and the P in the mark, leaves the logo and ties the whole surface together. Everything else is taken from the same logo kit and nothing else: its palette, its eight shading tones, its top-left light, its wide wordmark, its facets and its swallow. The world is user-pinned and international by design; the Philippines base is a fact stated in copy, never a visual theme.

The ground is Daylight, calm and open, broken by whole Partner Navy chapters (the voice section, the footer). Type is Partner Navy and does the work; colour is rationed. Alliance Blue is reserved for the single action that commits, so it reads as a decision rather than decoration. Ribbon Cyan is light: the ribbon's lit end, accents on navy, focus on navy. Depth is lit the way the 3D mark is lit, from the top left, with soft directional shadows and a lit top edge, never glow, with blur only where it does a job.

The system refuses the AI-agency default of a dark grid, glowing gradients and three identical feature cards, and the usual AI imagery (sparkles, glowing brains, circuit boards, robot faces, purple-and-pink gradients).
keyCharacteristics: Daylight ground with whole Partner Navy chapters; no other section grounds.
One Alliance Blue committing action per view; everything else interactive is navy.
The ribbon as the single signature: a satin band, lit from the top left, that twists to show its Partner 38 back.
Mona Sans Expanded display over normal-width text, Mona Sans Mono for sources, times and codes.
Depth lit from the top left: soft navy-tinted shadows and a lit top edge, never glow.

rules.name: The One Commitment Rule
rules.body: Alliance Blue fills exactly one committing action per view, the primary button. Links, accent words, form accents, checked controls, tabs and the current-city clock are never Alliance Blue. The focus ring stays blue as an accessibility affordance; the info alert's icon and edge and the first chart series are the only other blue, and they are status and data, not actions.

rules.name: The Navy Link Rule
rules.body: Links are Partner Navy and always underlined (a 1px underline at 45% that goes solid on hover); inside a navy chapter they turn Ribbon Cyan. Colour alone never marks a link.

rules.name: The Light Not Text Rule
rules.body: Ribbon Cyan is never text on a light ground. It is the ribbon's light, and on navy it is the accent.

rules.name: The Two Grounds Rule
rules.body: A section's ground is Daylight or a whole Partner Navy chapter. The sunken Neutral 50 is a well for code, tables and quiet panels, never a section ground.

rules.name: The Wide Voice Rule
rules.body: Width carries rank: Expanded for display, Semi-expanded for section headings, normal width for everything a reader reads at length.

rules.name: The Light Accent Rule
rules.body: The one marked word in a headline drops to regular weight (400) on light grounds and turns Ribbon Cyan on navy. Never Alliance Blue, never a gradient fill.

rules.name: The No Label Above Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading. There is no eyebrow role; dates and issue numbers go in a meta line below.

rules.name: The Top-Left Light Rule
rules.body: Every shadow and every gradient obeys one light source at the top left. A shadow that falls up or left, or a light that comes from below, is wrong.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Depth never comes from glow, bloom or neon, and blur is never decoration. The one material is the sticky header: translucent Daylight with a backdrop blur, a specific effect that keeps the bar legible over content scrolling beneath it and turns solid under reduced transparency. The ribbon is lit artwork, not a light source.

dos: Do draw every visual from the logo kit: the A+P ribbon mark, its palette and shading, the wave, facets, patterns and swallow. Nature is built from ribbon and facets.
Do keep Alliance Blue to the one committing action in view; make every other interactive accent Partner Navy (Ribbon Cyan inside a navy chapter).
Do light depth from the top left: navy-tinted shadows falling down and right, plus a lit top edge on raised planes.
Do set display type at Expanded width with negative tracking, and running text at normal width within 68ch.
Do put sources, times, codes and hex values in Mona Sans Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep all text at WCAG AA or better on its ground.
Do keep the glow of the graphic-wave artwork to hero and print use, never behind UI text or controls.
donts: Don't use Alliance Blue for links, accent words, checked controls, tabs or form accents.
Don't set Ribbon Cyan as text on Daylight or white.
Don't use the sunken Neutral 50 well, or any third tone, as a section ground.

Don't create depth with glow, neon or bloom, don't use blur as decoration (the sticky header's material is the one functional use), and don't draw the ribbon as a glowing line or as an offset copy of itself.
Don't put the Daybreak gradient behind small text, or fill text with a gradient.
Don't put a small label above a heading.
Don't use Philippine or other regional cultural motifs; the base is stated in copy, never shown as a theme.
Don't use sparkles, glowing brains, circuit boards, robot faces, or purple-and-pink gradients.
Don't use Print Black on screen.
